segments.narration: A beluga whale showed up wearing a harness labelled St Petersburg. Off Hammerfest, northern Norway, April 2019. It came straight up to the fishing boats.
The harness was tight-fitting, with a mount for a GoPro and no camera in it. The clasp read Equipment St Petersburg.
He played fetch. He brought a kayaker's dropped camera back up off the harbour floor. He answered hand signals. So who trained him?
Norway named him Hvaldimir, from hval, whale, plus Vladimir. Russia never confirmed a thing, and one Russian military commentator would not rule out a navy escape.
He was found dead near Stavanger in August 2024. No bullets: the post-mortem pointed at infection from a stick lodged in his mouth. Who sent him out is still unanswered.
